newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Aristocrat shrs fall on board shuffle.
newsitem.headline: Aristocrat shrs fall on board shuffle.

text.p: Shares in Aristocrat Industries Ltd fell over nine percent in early trade following another boardroom shuffle at the gaming machine maker.

Late on Wednesday, Aristocrat appointed former AWA Ltd managing director John Dougall as executive chairman and chief executive officer of the group. Dougall replaced Allan McDonald as chairman and Gary Garton as managing director.
Both Garton and Mcdonald resigned from the board.
At 10.55 a.m. (2355 GMT), Aristocrat shares were 30 cents or eight percent lower at A$3.45 on a volume of 333,800 shares, off the morning low of A$3.40.

The boardroom changes follow the re-shuffle at Aristocrat's annual meeting a month ago when three members of Ainsworth family, which controls about 58 percent of the stock, secured half of the six board seats.
The three were brother Mark, Simon and Paul, while another brother Geoffrey failed to win re-election.
"There is some concern in the market about what is happening in the boardroom as these moves are quite destablishing," one Sydney broker said.
Aristocrat floated on the sharemarket on July 9.
